entities.description: A red car with a black door handle and window frame is shown from the side, with the driver's side window open. Inside, a young woman with long black hair, wearing a white collared shirt and a seatbelt, sits in the passenger seat holding a white paper coffee cup. In the driver's seat, a young man with short black hair, wearing a white collared shirt and a green tie, is driving with both hands on the steering wheel.
